SELECT COUNT(d.disposal_id) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(od.order_detail_id), 0) AS disposalRatePct FROM order_details od JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN disposals d ON od.order_detail_id = d.order_detail_id -- 재고가 폐기테이블을 가지는 지 , 안가지는 경우도 카운트 해야하기에 포함 AND d.disposal_status IN ('승인', '완료') -- 이면서 폐기가 승인 or 완료여야 폐기로 간주 AND d.disposal_unit = '통폐기' WHERE od.order_status IN ('승인', '완료') --
AND o.order_at >= #{startDate} AND o.order_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT s.store_id AS storeId, s.store_name AS storeName, COUNT(od.order_detail_id) AS totalOrderCount, COUNT(d.disposal_id) AS totalDisposalCount, COUNT(d.disposal_id) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(od.order_detail_id), 0) AS disposalRatePct FROM stores s JOIN orders o ON s.store_id = o.store_id JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id LEFT JOIN disposals d ON od.order_detail_id = d.order_detail_id AND d.disposal_status IN ('승인', '완료') AND d.disposal_unit = '통폐기' WHERE od.order_status IN ('승인', '완료')
AND o.order_at >= #{startDate} AND o.order_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY s.store_id ORDER BY disposalRatePct DESC

SELECT i.ingredient_id AS ingredientId, i.ingredient_name AS ingredientName, SUM(d.disposal_price) AS totalDisposalPrice, SUM(d.disposal_quantity) AS totalDisposalQuantity FROM order_details od JOIN ingredients i ON od.ingredient_id = i.ingredient_id JOIN disposals d ON od.order_detail_id = d.order_detail_id AND d.disposal_status IN ('승인', '완료') WHERE od.order_status IN ('승인', '완료')
AND d.disposal_app_at >= #{startDate} AND d.disposal_app_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY ingredientId, ingredientName ORDER BY totalDisposalPrice DESC

SELECT s.store_id AS storeId, s.store_name AS storeName, COALESCE(SUM(d.disposal_price), 0) AS totalDisposalPrice, COALESCE(SUM(d.disposal_quantity), 0) AS totalDisposalQuantity FROM stores s LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.store_id = o.store_id LEFT JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id AND od.order_status IN ('승인', '완료') LEFT JOIN disposals d ON od.order_detail_id = d.order_detail_id AND d.disposal_status IN ('승인', '완료') AND d.disposal_app_at >= #{date} AND d.disposal_app_at < DATE_ADD(#{date}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name ORDER BY totalDisposalPrice DESC, s.store_id ASC

SELECT DATE(d.disposal_app_at) AS disposalDate, COUNT(d.disposal_id) AS disposalCount, SUM(d.disposal_quantity) AS totalDisposalQuantity, SUM(d.disposal_price) AS totalDisposalPrice FROM disposals d WHERE d.disposal_status IN ('승인', '완료') AND d.disposal_app_at >= DATE_SUB(#{today}, INTERVAL (#{day} - 1) DAY) AND d.disposal_app_at < DATE_ADD(#{today}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(d.disposal_app_at) ORDER BY disposalDate DESC
